annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/2346 laying down common specifications for the groups of products without an intended medical purpose listed in Annex XVI to Regulation (EU) 2017/745 on medical devices
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/2346 laying down common specifications for the groups of products without an intended medical purpose listed in Annex XVI to Regulation (EU) 2017/745 on medical devices
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 311/60
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Implementing Regulation setting common specifications for risk management, labelling and instructions for products without medical purpose (contact lenses, implants, fillers, fat-reduction equipment, lasers/IPL, transcranial brain stimulation) under the Medical Devices Regulation, with transitional arrangements. Not AI-related.
key_provisions_or_claims: Common specifications cover risk management for Annex XVI products under MDR 2017/745.
Annex I sets general risk management process, labelling and instructions-for-use requirements.
Annexes II-VII add product-specific risks and controls (lenses, implants, fillers, fat reduction, lasers/IPL, brain stimulation).
Transitional arrangements allow marketed products until 2025-2028 subject to conditions.
